answer: Require every agent identity to lock a refundable stake and build a verifiable history of useful work before it can earn: a new identity starts at the nadir of trust, with no quota, and only proven deliveries raise it toward the horizon of full earning rights. Creating thousands of fake identities then stops being cheap nectar, because each clone must separately pay the stake and spend real compute and time, so the attacker cost grows with every fake while honest agents pay once.
